questions.stem: Which noun best describes Ling's activity?
questions.listenScript: Ling puts equal pieces of ice in two cups and places the cups in different parts of the room. She records how quickly each piece melts to check an idea.

questions.parentExplanation: 她设置条件并记录结果来检验想法，是experiment实验，不是调查问卷或日记本。

passages.text: Zoe has only a little pocket money, but she wants a book about cooking. At a second-hand book stall, she finds one with a torn cover. Its price is low, so she can buy it without using all her money. Before paying, she reads the introduction at the front. It explains that the recipes use simple tools found in most kitchens. Zoe checks the pages and sees that none are missing. She takes the book home and chooses a recipe to try with Dad.

parallelText.en: Zoe has only a little pocket money, but she wants a book about cooking.
parallelText.zh: 佐伊的零花钱不多，但她想买本烹饪书。

parallelText.en: At a second-hand book stall, she finds one with a torn cover.
parallelText.zh: 在旧书摊上，她找到一本封面破了的书。

parallelText.en: Its price is low, so she can buy it without using all her money.
parallelText.zh: 这本书价格低，因此她不用花光钱就能买下。

parallelText.en: Before paying, she reads the introduction at the front.
parallelText.zh: 付款前，她读了书前面的引言。

parallelText.en: It explains that the recipes use simple tools found in most kitchens.
parallelText.zh: 引言说明，食谱使用大多数厨房都有的简单工具。

parallelText.en: Zoe checks the pages and sees that none are missing.
parallelText.zh: 佐伊检查书页，发现一页都没少。

parallelText.en: She takes the book home and chooses a recipe to try with Dad.
parallelText.zh: 她把书带回家，选了一个食谱准备和爸爸尝试。

passages.text: One rainy afternoon, Ana finds a postcard from her cousin in another town. The picture shows a bridge that is new to Ana. She decides to send a card back instead of writing only a short message. She draws the pond near her home and adds three sentences about it. The cards give both cousins a chance to learn about each other's neighbourhood. When the next card arrives, Ana marks the new place on a small map. Soon their map has pictures from both towns.

parallelText.en: One rainy afternoon, Ana finds a postcard from her cousin in another town.
parallelText.zh: 一个下雨的下午，安娜收到住在另一座镇子的表亲寄来的明信片。

parallelText.en: The picture shows a bridge that is new to Ana.
parallelText.zh: 图画显示一座对安娜来说很陌生的桥。

parallelText.en: She decides to send a card back instead of writing only a short message.
parallelText.zh: 她决定回寄一张卡片，而不是只写一条简短消息。

parallelText.en: She draws the pond near her home and adds three sentences about it.
parallelText.zh: 她画下家附近的池塘，并写上三句介绍。

parallelText.en: The cards give both cousins a chance to learn about each other's neighbourhood.
parallelText.zh: 卡片给表亲俩一个了解彼此居住地的机会。

parallelText.en: When the next card arrives, Ana marks the new place on a small map.
parallelText.zh: 下一张卡片到来时，安娜把新地方标在一张小地图上。

parallelText.en: Soon their map has pictures from both towns.
parallelText.zh: 很快，地图上就有了两座镇子的图片。
